_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: System Safety Program Progress Report (SSPPR)
summary: The System Safety Program Progress Report (SSPPR) is used to cover periodic reviews of safety activities and to monitor progress of contractor system safety efforts.
use_relationship:
The System Safety Program Progress Report (SSPPR) is used to cover periodic reviews of safety activities and to monitor progress of contractor system safety efforts.

a. This Data Item Description (DID) contains the content and format preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.

b. This DID is related to DI-SAFT-80101, System Safety Hazard Analysis Report (SSHAR); DI-SAFT-80102, Safety Assessment Report (SAR); DI-SAFT-80106, Health Hazard Assessment Report (HHAR), and DI-SAFT-82085, Hazard Tracking System (HTS) Data.

c. Do not use DI-ADMN-81250, Conference Minutes, in conjunction with this DID. (Copies of these DIDs are available online at http://quicksearch.dla.mil.)

d. This DID supersedes DI-SAFT-80105C.

references.label: Copies of these DIDs are available online

distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The SSPPR shall be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The SSPPR shall include a description of the general progress made relative to the system safety program during the reporting period and the projected work for the next reporting period. The report shall contain the following information in narrative form:

children.title: A brief summary of activities, progress, and status of the safety effort
Significant achievements and problems
children.content: It shall highlight significant achievements and problems.

children.title: Progress toward completion of safety data items prepared or in work
children.content: It shall include progress toward completion of safety data items prepared or in work.

children.title: Status toward completion of Level of Rigor (LOR) task activities
children.content: It shall include a status toward completion of Level of Rigor (LOR) task activities.

children.title: Newly recognized significant hazards and significant changes in the degree of control on known hazards
Inventory of identified hazards
children.content: Inventory of identified hazards, with each hazard tabulated by sequence number, identified by the initial risk index value and revised risk index value after incorporation of hazard mitigation, action taken to date, and its action status: open, closed, or monitor. Include any hazards which the contractor believes cannot be reduced to an acceptable level of risk and will require managing activity action.

children.title: Status of all recommended mitigation measures that have not been implemented and the date of hazard resolution
Significant cost, schedule, and performance changes that impact the safety program
Discussion of documents reviewed by safety during the reporting period
children.content: Discussion of documents reviewed by safety during the reporting period. Indicate whether they were acceptable for safety content and whether or not inputs to improve the safety posture were made.

children.title: Discussion of specific efforts for each unit of software to determine Software Criticality Index (SwCI)
children.content: Discussion of specific efforts for each unit of software to determine Software Criticality Index (SwCI) as well as developing the artifacts documenting completion of LOR task activities.

children.title: Proposed agenda for future system safety meeting(s)
Minutes of the past system safety meeting(s)
